episodes.synopsis: Illya has been chosen by the Kaleidostick Ruby to become the new magical girl.
episodes.title: Birth! A Magical Girl!

episodes.synopsis: A challenger appears, just when Illya is having trouble collecting the Rider card under Rin's instructions.
episodes.title: Who?

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious transfer student, Miyu Edelfelt, has joined Illya's class. Is she friend or rival?
episodes.title: Girl Meets Girl

episodes.synopsis: Illya and her friends have been defeated by Caster. They must figure out how to improve their teamwork in order to win the rematch.
episodes.title: We Lost

episodes.synopsis: There is no time to celebrate their hard-won victory, as Saber card suddenly appears to strike down Rin and Luvia. Faced with their strongest opponent yet, which option will Illya and Miyu choose?
episodes.title: There are two options?

episodes.synopsis: Illya calls upon the power of the Archer card to defeat Saber.
episodes.title: A Blank, and the End of Night…

episodes.synopsis: Illya stays home to recover from a fever, but gets into some hijinks with Miyu. That night they attempt to capture the Assassin card.
episodes.title: Triumph and Escape

episodes.synopsis: Suffering from shell shock, Illya tells Rin she wants to resign from being a magical girl. But fate has something different in store for her.
episodes.title: The Normal Girl has Returned

episodes.synopsis: Miyu attempts to capture the last card by herself using Saber's power.
episodes.title: End it Here

episodes.synopsis: Illya and Miyu must combine their strength in order to defeat Berserker whose Noble Phantasm allows him instant resurrections.
episodes.title: Kaleidoscope
